title: How scores & XP work
subtitle: Everything you need to know about Quiz/Exam scores, XP and levels
intro: This page explains in plain language: how your work is graded, how much XP each action earns, and how much XP you need to level up.

quiz.card_subtitle: Each question has 4 options — pick the best one.
quiz.max_grade_value: {{value}} points. Teachers can adjust this from 1 to 10.
quiz.passing_value: You pass with ≥ {{pct}}%. Teachers can adjust this.
quiz.perfect_value: Score 100% and earn a bonus +20 XP 🎉
quiz.formula_value: Score = (correct answers ÷ total questions) × max score
quiz.example_text: Quiz with 10 questions, max 10 points. You get 8 right → 8/10 × 10 = 8.0 points.

exam.card_subtitle: Exams can be multiple choice, file upload, essay or proctored online.
exam.max_grade_value: {{value}} points. Teachers can adjust this from 1 to {{max}}.
exam.passing_value: You pass with ≥ {{pct}}% (for MC and online exams).
exam.ai_value: AI grades on 5 criteria: Accuracy 30% + Completeness 20% + Critical thinking 20% + Terminology 15% + Form 15% = 100%
exam.formula_value: Score = (correct answers ÷ total questions) × max score
exam.example_text: Exam with 20 MC questions, max 10 points. You get 15 right → 15/20 × 10 = 7.5 points.

xp.card_subtitle: Each action you take earns XP. XP accumulates over time to compute your level and global rank.

level.card_subtitle: Your level grows with XP. Higher levels need more XP.
level.tip_value: Submit work on time, pass quizzes, and earn certificates to level up faster.

leaderboard.card_subtitle: This is the leaderboard inside a single classroom (not the global ranking).
leaderboard.example_text: Quiz avg 80%, exam avg 60% → 80 × 0.6 + 60 × 0.4 = 72 classroom points.
